<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="אייר_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518918601_theRebbe_37" batchId="meluket-_D7_90_D7_99_D7_99_D7_A8_meluket__BH_POST_1766518918601_theRebbe_37__p006">
  <section v="15">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Through studying and disseminating the inner dimension of Torah, especially as revealed in Chassidus, one attains the future revelation of Pnimiyus HaTorah, which will be the entire world's occupation in the true and complete redemption.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">10)</t>
    <t s="1">And this is the explanation:</t>
    <t s="2">And through the study and dissemination of the inner dimension of Torah,</t>
    <t s="3">the Torah of Rashbi,</t>
    <t s="4">and particularly as it was revealed in the teachings of Chassidus,</t>
    <t s="5">a revelation in the manner of "yitparnason,"</t>
    <t s="6">understanding and comprehension,</t>
    <t s="7">to the point that the intellect of the person studying becomes one with the subject he studies,</t>
    <t s="8">[which is similar to what was explained above regarding "Gal Einai,"</t>
    <t s="9">that seeing the wonders of Torah is from the aspect of the person's own essence],</t>
    <t s="10">they merit the revelation of the inner dimension of Torah that will be in the future,</t>
    <t s="11">for the revelation then will be additional to that which comes from Above, but rather this will be the very substance of the world,</t>
    <t s="12">as the Rambam states,</t>
    <t s="13">"And the entire world's occupation will be solely to know G-d, etc.,"</t>
    <t s="14">as it is said,</t>
    <t s="15">"For the earth will be filled with knowledge of G-d as the waters cover the sea,"</t>
    <t s="16">in the true and complete redemption through our righteous Moshiach,</t>
    <t s="17">speedily, indeed.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
